itemDesc: A container for storing high volumes of liquids. Nearby structures and vehicles can refill directly from this container.
A container that can carry large quantities of resources and can be transported by certain vehicles.
Shippable Crates contain multiple packed vehicles or structures of the same kind. These vehicles or structures must be first unpacked at a Storage Depot before they can be used.
A container for shipping very large quantities of Crates using Crane loaded vehicles. This type of container can only be unloaded at Storage Depots and Seaports.
